label: Walked, cycled or took public transport
why: Travel is often one of the biggest parts of a person's carbon footprint.

label: Ate a meat-free meal
why: Plant-based meals usually need less land, water and energy than meat.

label: Used a reusable bottle, bag or container
why: Reusing cuts the waste and energy of making single-use items.

label: Switched off lights, fans or AC I was not using
why: Saving electricity cuts emissions where power comes from fossil fuels.

label: Took a short shower
why: Heating water takes energy, so less time means less energy.

label: Sorted my rubbish for recycling
why: Recycling usually uses less energy than making things from raw materials.

label: Finished my meal with no food waste
why: Wasted food wastes the energy and water used to make it.

label: Answered today's quiz correctly
why: The quiz explanation is the lesson.
